title: 形容词副词比较级
goal: 能根据比较对象和范围选择比较等级及正确形式。

points.label: 根据比较对象和范围判断比较等级
正确填写形容词或副词的比较形式

body.p: 形容词和副词可以用原级、比较级和最高级表示程度。用哪一级，看比较的对象、范围和句中的标志词。

body.box: This route is shorter than that one. / This is the shortest of the three routes.

body.p: than 引出比较对象；of the three routes 表示最高级的范围。

cards.title: 比较等级
rows: This box is heavier than that one.
The two boxes are as heavy as each other.
表示在一个范围内程度最高
It is the longest of the three paths.
表示两个变化相互关联
The more she reads, the more she learns.
This road is much wider than that one.
This bag is far lighter than mine.
表示进一步的程度差别
Today is even colder than yesterday.

cards.title: 比较形式
rows: This room is smaller than mine.
This is the largest room here.
The bigger box is on the floor.
This task is easier than the last one.
Mina is more careful than Leo.
Mina writes more carefully than Leo.
This plan is better than the first.
The second road is worse than the first.

cards.title: 辨析
rows: This path is shorter than that one. / It is the shortest of the three.
than 比较两者；of 表示范围
Mia is as tall as Ben. / Mia is taller than Ben.
as … as 用原级；than 前用比较级
This is a careful worker. / She works carefully.
形容词修饰名词；副词修饰动词
The new room is much larger. / It is even larger than mine.
much 和 even 修饰比较级
The more he practices, the better he plays. / The less he rests, the more tired he becomes.
前后两部分都用 the + 比较级

items.stem: The red box is (heavy) than the blue one.
items.why: than 前用比较级，heavy 的 y 变 i。

items.stem: This path is the (long) of the three paths.
items.why: 三条路的范围内用最高级 longest。

items.stem: The two ropes have the same length. This rope is as (long) as that one.
This room is (big) than the other one.
items.why: big 双写 g 再加 -er。
carefully 的比较级用 more carefully。

items.stem: The second plan is (good) than the first.
items.why: good 的比较级是不规则形式 better。

items.stem: The more he practices, the (well) he plays.
items.why: 关联变化的后一部分用比较级 better。

items.stem: This is the (easy) of the three tasks.
items.why: 三项中的最高级把 y 变 i 再加 -est。

groups.text: A class compared three routes between the school and a community garden. The students walked each route on a different day and recorded its length. The first route passed a row of shops. The second followed a quiet street and was [1] than the first. The third went around a park and was the [2] of the three routes. The class also measured two benches along the way. The benches were as [3] as each other, although their colors were different. One group drew a map of the streets, while another group wrote directions. After reading the first draft, the teacher asked the writers to describe the turns more clearly. The students found that the more details they checked, the [4] their directions became. They also tried a different way to mark the crossing. The new symbol was much [5] than the old one, so it was easier to see on the map. At the end of the project, the class placed the map and directions in the school library. Other students could use them when visiting the garden and suggest corrections if a street changed.

items.stem: [1] The second route was (short) than the first.
[2] The third route was the (long) of the three routes.
items.why: of the three 表示最高级范围。

items.stem: [3] The benches were as (wide) as each other.
items.why: as … as 之间用原级 wide。

items.stem: [4] The more details they checked, the (good) their directions became.
items.why: 关联变化用比较级，good 的比较级是 better。

items.stem: [5] The new symbol was much (big) than the old one.
items.why: much 修饰比较级；big 双写 g 再加 -er。

groups.text: A group of students tested different ways to protect seedlings during a windy day. They placed three identical pots in an open area and used a different cover for each one. The first cover was made of thin paper. The second was made of card and was [1] than the paper cover. The third cover had a frame and was the [2] of the three. The students observed the pots from the same distance and wrote down what happened. They repeated the observation later, when the wind was even [3] than before. The group then compared the notes. One student had recorded the movements [4] than the others, including the time of each change. Those detailed notes helped the group understand the order of events. The teacher asked the students to explain what they had learned without assuming that one test settled every question. They proposed repeating the activity with covers of different sizes. The more often they observed the pots, the [5] it became to notice small changes. The group kept the covers and notes for use in a later lesson.

items.stem: [1] The card cover was (strong) than the paper cover.
[2] The framed cover was the (stable) of the three.
items.why: 三者范围内用 stable 的最高级 most stable。

items.stem: [3] The wind was even (strong) than before.
[4] One student recorded the movements (carefully) than the others.
items.why: 副词 carefully 的比较级是 more carefully。

items.stem: [5] The more often they observed the pots, the (easy) it became to notice changes.
items.why: 关联变化中用比较级，easy 变为 easier。
